contentHtml:
Australian meat pie greets you with a golden, buttery crust that shatters gently to reveal a rich, comforting center. Inside, tender beef simmers in a savory gravy of tomato, Worcestershire sauce, tangy beef stock, sweet carrots, onions, and a sprinkle of thyme and rosemary. Every forkful delivers cozy flavor, pairing crisp flaky pastry with a smooth, deeply seasoned filling that feels like a warm memory. Serve your australian meat pie on chilly evenings or bring it to an easygoing brunch, and enjoy a delicious little taste of Down Under in every bite.

Why You’ll Love This australian meat pie

  • Hearty and satisfying, perfect for any meal.
  • Easy to customize with your favorite fillings.
  • Brings a taste of Australia right to your kitchen.
  • Great for sharing at gatherings or enjoying solo.

australian meat pie

Discover the ultimate Australian meat pie recipe! 🍖🥧 Create this easy, savory delight at home and impress your taste buds!
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 20 minutes mins
Cook Time 30 minutes mins
resting 5 minutes mins
Total Time 55 minutes mins
Servings: 4 servings
Course: Main Course
Cuisine: Australian
Calories: 350
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Filling
  • 500 g beef mince fresh or lean, for a hearty filling
  • 1 unit onion finely chopped, adds sweetness and depth
  • 2 cloves garlic minced, for aromatic flavor
Butter
  • 2 tbsp butter for richness and sautéing
  • 2 tbsp plain flour to thicken the filling
  • 1 cup beef stock enhances meaty flavor
  • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce for a umami kick
  • to taste unit salt and pepper for seasoning
Pastry
  • 2 sheets shortcrust pastry for a buttery and flaky crust
  • 1 unit egg beaten for egg wash, to give a golden finish

Equipment

  • 2 pie tins For baking the pies
  • 1 Pan For cooking the filling

Method
 

Preparation
  1. Preheat your oven to 200°C. This ensures a perfectly baked pie.
  2. Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Let it get nice and bubbly.
  3. Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan. Cook until softened and fragrant.
  4. Add beef mince to the pan. Brown it evenly, stirring occasionally.
  5. Sprinkle flour over the beef mixture. Stir and cook for 1 minute to combine.
  6. Gradually pour in beef stock while stirring. This will help thicken the filling.
  7. Add Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Let it simmer for 5–10 minutes until thick.
  8. Roll out one sheet of pastry and line individual pie tins. Make sure it fits snugly.
  9. Spoon the thick filling into the lined tins. Don’t overfill, or they might spill!
  10. Cover the filling with a second sheet of pastry. Seal the edges well.
  11. Trim any excess pastry and cut a small vent on top. Brush the tops with beaten egg.
  12. Bake in the preheated oven for 25–30 minutes until golden brown and delicious.
  13. Allow the pies to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Enjoy your homemade delight!

How to Make Australian Meat Pie

This delightful Australian meat pie is a savory treat that’s perfect for any occasion. With a preparation time of about 20 minutes and a cooking time of 30 minutes, you’ll have these delicious pies ready to enjoy in no time. Don’t forget to let them rest for 5 minutes after baking for the best flavor!

Preheat your oven to 200°C. This ensures a perfectly baked pie.

Step 2: Melt Butter

Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Let it get nice and bubbly.

Step 3: Cook Onion and Garlic

Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan. Cook until softened and fragrant.

Step 4: Brown the Beef

Step 5: Stir in Flour

Step 6: Add Beef Stock

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making australian meat pie

  • Choose high-quality beef for a richer flavor.
  • Let the filling cool before adding it to the pie crust.
  • Brush the crust with egg wash for a golden finish.
  • Experiment with herbs like thyme or rosemary for added depth.
  • Serve with tomato sauce for a classic touch.

How to Serve this australian meat pie

  • Serve warm with a dollop of tomato sauce for that classic touch.
  • Pair with a fresh garden salad for a refreshing contrast.
  • Enjoy with mashed potatoes or creamy coleslaw on the side.
  • For a twist, try adding a side of sweet potato fries.

Make Ahead and Storage

Storing and enjoying your Australian meat pie later is easy!

Storing Leftovers

  • Allow the pie to cool completely before storing.
  • Wrap it tightly in plastic wrap or aluminum foil.
  • Place it in an airtight container for extra protection.
  • Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Freezing

  • Cool the pie completely before freezing.
  • Wrap it tightly in plastic wrap, then in aluminum foil.
  • Label with the date and type of pie.
  • Freeze for up to 3 months for best quality.

Reheating

  • Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).
  • Remove any wrapping and place the pie on a baking sheet.
  • Cover loosely with foil to prevent over-browning.
  • Heat for about 20-25 minutes or until warmed through.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What is a meat pie in Australia?

A meat pie in Australia is a savory pastry filled with minced meat, gravy, and often vegetables. It’s a beloved snack or meal option, commonly enjoyed at sporting events, bakeries, and homes across the country. The flaky crust encases a rich filling, making it a comforting and hearty dish that represents Australian cuisine well.

2. What is aussie slang for meat pie?

In Aussie slang, a meat pie is often affectionately referred to as a ‘pie’ or ‘meat pie.’ Sometimes, you might hear it called a ‘pasty’ or ‘party pie’ depending on the size and style. These terms reflect the casual and friendly nature of Australian culture, where food is often enjoyed in a relaxed setting.

3. What is a patty pie in Australia?

A patty pie in Australia is a smaller version of the traditional meat pie, typically filled with minced meat and gravy, similar to a meat pie but often served as a snack or quick meal. They are popular at parties and gatherings, making them a favorite among kids and adults alike for their bite-sized convenience.

4. Why is it called 420 pies?

The term ‘420 pies’ is often associated with a specific type of meat pie that is popular in Australia, particularly in relation to the culture surrounding cannabis. The number 420 has become a slang term for cannabis consumption, and some pie shops have playfully adopted this term to market their products. However, it’s important to note that not all meat pies are linked to this term, and many are simply enjoyed for their delicious flavors.

Final Thoughts

There you have it—your very own authentic Australian meat pie! This delightful dish is not only simple to make but also a heartwarming reminder of cozy gatherings and good times. So roll up your sleeves, get cooking, and savor every bite. Enjoy the deliciousness and the smiles it brings to your table!
